import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
CHARGED=set("DEKR"); SMALL=set("GASTCNDV")
OM={'G':2.0,'A':2.0,'S':2.0,'N':2.0,'D':2.0,'C':1.5,'T':0.5,'V':0.0}
uf=lambda a:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
PANEL=[("O13854","Sp Adg2","QUERY"),("P22146","Sc Gas1","GPI+"),("P32329","Sc Yps1","GPI+"),
 ("P43497","Sc Cwp2","GPI+"),("P28319","Sc Cwp1","GPI+"),("Q01589","Sc Sed1","GPI+"),
 ("P32768","Sc Sag1","GPI+"),("P53301","Sc Crh1","GPI+"),("P27654","Sc Tip1","GPI+"),
 ("Q05031","Sc Dfg5","GPI+"),("O13960","Sp Ecm33","GPI+"),("Q9UR09","Sp Psu1","GPI+"),
 ("Q9P378","Sp Gas1","GPI+"),("Q92340","Sp Shu1","GPI+"),("Q9Y7S9","Sp Aah3","GPI+"),
 ("O94549","Sp SPCC1322.10","GPI+(UniProt)"),("P00724","Sc Suc2","non-GPI"),("P00635","Sc Pho5","non-GPI"),
 ("P16474","Sc Kar2","non-GPI"),("P60010","Sc Act1","non-GPI"),("O74346","Sp Map4","non-GPI"),
 ("Q12215","Sc Wsc1","TM/other"),("Q9P7E7","Sp Adg1","untested"),("O74851","Sp Adg3","untested"),
 ("S9W079","Scryo adg2-ortholog","ortholog"),("S9R663","Soct adg2-ortholog","ortholog"),
 ("O74947","Sp SPCC553.10","paralog")]
S={a:uf(a) for a,_,_ in PANEL}
def chd(seq,maxlook=45,min_kd=1.0):
    n=len(seq);best=None
    for L in range(5,min(maxlook,n)+1):
        suf=seq[n-L:]
        if any(c in CHARGED for c in suf): continue
        m=np.mean([KD[c] for c in suf if c in KD])
        if m>=min_kd: best=(n-L,L,m)
    return best
def gpi(seq):
    n=len(seq);h=chd(seq)
    if h is None: return dict(score=np.nan,omega=None,res=None,w2=None,clen=0,ckd=np.nan,kr=None,ranked=[])
    p,L,kd=h; cands=[]
    for w in range(max(0,p-15),p-6):
        r=seq[w]
        if r not in OM or w+2>=n: continue
        s=OM[r]+(0.5 if seq[w+1] not in "PW" else -1.0)+(1.5 if seq[w+2] in SMALL else -1.0)\
          +(1.5 if L>=10 else (1.0 if L>=8 else -1.0))+(1.5 if kd>=2.0 else 1.0)\
          +(0.5 if sum(c in CHARGED for c in seq[w+3:p])<=1 else -0.5)
        cands.append((round(s,2),w+1,seq[w],seq[w+1],seq[w+2],p-w))
    cands.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]))
    if not cands: return dict(score=np.nan,omega=None,res=None,w2=None,clen=L,ckd=kd,kr=None,ranked=[])
    s,om,r,r1,r2,d=cands[0]
    return dict(score=s,omega=om,res=r,w2=r2,clen=L,ckd=round(kd,2),
                kr=sum(c in "KR" for c in seq[max(0,om-5):om+2]),ranked=cands[:6])
res=[]
for a,lab,cls in PANEL:
    g=gpi(S[a]); res.append(dict(acc=a,protein=lab,cls=cls,score=g["score"],omega=g["omega"],
      omega_res=g["res"],w2=g["w2"],tail_len=g["clen"],tail_KD=g["ckd"],KR_wm4_to_wp2=g["kr"],Cterm=S[a][-26:]))
D=pd.DataFrame(res)
D["score_plot"]=D["score"].fillna(0.0)
pd.set_option("display.width",260);pd.set_option("display.max_columns",40)
print(D.to_string(index=False))
print("\nAdg2 ranked omega candidates (score, omega_pos, w, w+1, w+2, dist_to_tail):")
for c in gpi(S["O13854"])["ranked"]: print("  ",c)
print("\nAdg2 C-terminal 30 with numbering:")
s=S["O13854"]
print("  "+" ".join(f"{s[i]}{i+1}" for i in range(len(s)-30,len(s))))

# ---- Figure ----
order=["QUERY","ortholog","GPI+","GPI+(UniProt)","paralog","untested","TM/other","non-GPI"]
colors={"QUERY":"#c0392b","ortholog":"#e67e22","GPI+":"#2471a3","GPI+(UniProt)":"#5dade2",
        "paralog":"#7d3c98","untested":"#7f8c8d","TM/other":"#117864","non-GPI":"#515a5a"}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1,1.25]})
ax=axes[0]
for i,cl in enumerate(order):
    sub=D[D.cls==cl]
    y=sub["score"].fillna(-1.0).values
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(y),i)+np.linspace(-0.18,0.18,len(y)),y,s=70,color=colors[cl],
               edgecolor="k",linewidth=0.5,zorder=3)
ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.8)
ax.axhspan(-1.6,-0.4,color="#eeeeee",zorder=0)
ax.text(7.4,-1.0,"no uncharged\nhydrophobic C-tail",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8,color="#444")
q=D.loc[D.protein=="Sp Adg2","score"].iloc[0]
ax.annotate(f"Adg2 = {q}",(0,q),xytext=(1.2,8.4),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b"),color="#c0392b",fontsize=11)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order)));ax.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=35,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("GPI C-terminal signal score (this study)")
ax.set_title("Adg2 scores above all verified fungal GPI proteins")
ax.set_ylim(-1.8,9.2)

ax=axes[1]
show=[("O13854","Sp Adg2","#c0392b",2.4),("S9W079","S. cryophilus ortholog","#e67e22",1.4),
      ("S9R663","S. octosporus ortholog","#f1c40f",1.4),("P22146","Sc Gas1 (GPI)","#2471a3",1.2),
      ("P32329","Sc Yps1 (GPI)","#5dade2",1.2),("O74346","Sp Map4 (no GPI)","#515a5a",1.2),
      ("P00724","Sc Suc2 (no GPI)","#95a5a6",1.2)]
W=7
for a,lab,c,lw in show:
    seq=S[a][-60:]
    h=[np.mean([KD[x] for x in seq[i:i+W]]) for i in range(len(seq)-W+1)]
    xs=np.arange(-60+W//2,-60+W//2+len(h))
    ax.plot(xs,h,color=c,lw=lw,label=lab)
ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",color="grey",lw=0.8)
ax.text(-59,1.75,"hydrophobic threshold",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("residue position relative to C terminus")
ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (window 7)")
ax.set_title("C-terminal hydropathy: Adg2 and its orthologs match GPI proteins")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
